definitions.NLL_worsening: NLL_trained4_endpoint - NLL_trained2_endpoint; positive means worse trained4 NLL
definitions.AUROC_change: AUROC_trained4 - AUROC_trained2, summarized over fitted seeds
definitions.high_confidence_error: Case p<=0.05 with malignant label, or p>=0.95 with benign label; inclusive
definitions.probability_boundary_counts: Exact Case-average p=0 and p=1 counts, and wrong-label predictions at those boundaries; saturation audit only
definitions.classification_transitions: Case correct/wrong transition between separately fitted endpoints at fixed threshold 0.5
definitions.loss_concentration: Descriptive sensitivity to largest per-Case gains/absolute changes; no Case removed from primary metrics
definitions.seed_std: sample SD ddof=1 of fitted-seed metrics, not a seed-population interval
definitions.bootstrap: first average paired seed-specific effects within each Case, then resample aligned Cases; no ensemble prediction averaging

limitations: The five new seeds replicate training randomness on the already observed fixed tune cohort; they do not supply new patients or untouched validation.
The resource gate is an engineering rule, not statistical significance or clinical validation; passing never automatically authorizes expansion.
The secondary eight-seed description cannot override a failed five-new-seed gate.
Paired Case bootstrap intervals condition on fitted models; they exclude training-seed population uncertainty.
Case-to-patient mapping remains unverified; patient independence is not established.
Equal optimizer updates and Case exposure do not equalize recurrent compute; trained4 uses more block applications.
Intermediate terminal-only readouts are diagnostic and not directly supervised; primary comparisons use trained endpoints only.
Calibration and test predictions are absent; frozen features, no augmentation and resized Dice limit the scope.
